assertions.statement: inspect, validate, and build run offline without API keys.
Parser produces the required semantic objects and never imports DOCX implementation modules.
Validation reports duplicate IDs, missing references, images, citations, metadata, and template errors structurally.
Compiler resolves deterministic numbering, bookmarks, references, citations, and sections before rendering.
Generated DOCX contains real TOC, SEQ, REF, Bookmark, PAGE, OMML, footnote, section, header, and footer structures.
A full example thesis builds successfully and opens in a supported Office client.
A failed rebuild preserves the previously valid output file.
Static checks, package tests, architecture checks, and OOXML structure tests pass.
A local HTML prototype presents the ThesisForge workbench across desktop, mobile, and required review states.
